Description

About Us:

Panelmatic, Inc. was founded in 1957 in Youngstown, OH to serve manufacturing industries with the design and building of custom electrical, instrument, and pneumatic control panels. Our business has sufficiently grown over the years to support expansion for our clients. We have produced control panels and buildings for many of America's top corporations in the chemical, environmental, food, pulp, paper, rubber, petroleum, pharmaceutical, glass, metals, data center, renewables, and utilities industries. We also deliver equipment for use worldwide. Our rigorous methodology ensures compliance with domestic and international standards. We can meet the needs of our diverse clientele from start to finish through sales, design, fabrication, testing, and delivery.

Since 1957, we have been known for our high-quality, custom-built control packages, our comprehensive service, and our technological and manufacturing expertise. This expertise assures you of our ability to handle the largest and most complex packages quickly and efficiently.

Job Summary:

Panelmatic is seeking an AI & Automation Engineer to design, develop, and support practical artificial intelligence and automation solutions that improve engineering and business processes. The role will initially focus on Engineering and Design workflow automation, reducing repetitive work, improving information flow, and building internal knowledge of solutions currently supported by external partners. Over time, this position will help extend responsible, scalable AI and automation capabilities across other Panelmatic functions. This is a hands-on individual contributor role within IT that will initially be reported to the CIO / VP of IT and is expected to align under the future IT organization.

Job Duties:

• Develop, test, deploy, and maintain AI-enabled applications, workflow automations, scripts, integrations, and data-processing solutions.

• Partner with Engineering, Design, Manufacturing, Quality, Operations, and IT stakeholders to identify repetitive work, process bottlenecks, and high-value automation opportunities.

• Initially support engineering and design automation, including document and drawing workflows, data extraction and transformation, engineering knowledge search, application integrations, and automated handoffs.

• Work with the Solution Architect, PLM and engineering application owners to ensure automations align with the future PLM, CAD, ERP, and digital engineering architecture.

• Collaborate with external engineering and automation partners to understand existing solutions, document technical knowledge, support knowledge transfer, and transition appropriate capabilities to Panelmatic.

• Build reusable solutions using technologies such as Python, APIs, low-code automation, generative AI, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, data pipelines, and cloud services.

• Create prototypes and proofs of concept, validate business value with users, and convert successful concepts into secure, supportable production solutions.

• Develop and maintain technical documentation, source code, solution diagrams, support procedures, and knowledge articles.

• Integrate AI and automation solutions with approved enterprise platforms while maintaining data quality, access controls, cybersecurity, privacy, and responsible AI practices.

• Monitor solution performance, accuracy, usage, reliability, and cost; troubleshoot issues and continuously improve delivered solutions.

• Provide user training and adoption support to help teams effectively use new AI and automation capabilities.

• Support the intake, prioritization, and value tracking of AI and automation opportunities across Panelmatic.

• Remain current on AI, automation, engineering application, and manufacturing technology trends and recommend practical opportunities for Panelmatic.

• Other duties as assigned by supervisor.

Requirements

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field required; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
One plus years of hands-on experience developing software, automation, data, machine learning, or AI solutions required.
Hands-on programming experience with Python and working knowledge of APIs, SQL, data transformation, and source control required.
Foundational experience with generative AI, large language models, machine learning, intelligent document processing, or workflow automation required.
Ability to translate business problems into practical technical solutions and explain technical concepts to non-technical users required.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, communication, and collaboration skills required.
Ability to learn engineering and manufacturing processes, applications, terminology, and data structures required.
Ability to manage multiple assignments, work independently, and collaborate with internal teams and external partners required.
Ability to pass physical, drug, driving, and background check required.
Ability to physically push, pull, and lift 25lbs or more required.
Ability to sit, stand, and walk for four plus hours at a time required.
Alignment with company core values required.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with generative AI frameworks, retrieval-augmented generation, AI agents, vector databases, prompt engineering, model evaluation, or MLOps preferred.
Experience with Microsoft Azure, AWS, Databricks, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, FastAPI, or similar cloud and software delivery technologies preferred.
Experience with Microsoft Power Platform, Power Automate, Azure AI services, Copilot Studio, or similar enterprise automation platforms preferred.
Exposure to manufacturing, engineering design, CAD, PLM, ERP, document management, or industrial workflows preferred.
Experience working with third-party development or engineering partners and supporting knowledge transfer preferred.
Knowledge of responsible AI, cybersecurity, data privacy, model monitoring, and solution governance preferred.

KPIs:

Automation Value Delivered: measurable hours saved, cycle-time reduction, quality improvement, or cost avoidance from implemented solutions
Solution Delivery: prioritized automations and AI use cases delivered on time and accepted by business users
Adoption and User Satisfaction: active usage, user feedback, and sustained adoption of released solutions
Knowledge Transfer and Insourcing: external solutions documented, support knowledge transferred, and appropriate capabilities transitioned internally
Solution Reliability and Governance: availability, accuracy, security, supportability, and compliance with Panelmatic technology standards
Benefits
Medical, dental, vision, HSA, term life, AD&D, STD, LTD
100% medical premium paid for by Panelmatic for the employee-only level medical coverage
80% paid for by Panelmatic and 20% paid for by the employee on all other level medical coverage (i.e. employee plus child, employee plus spouse, family)
401(k) contributions matched 100% up to 4% 
Scholarships, educational reimbursement, paid volunteerism, and paid personal and professional development provided
PTO and paid holidays provided
Career advancement opportunities
Competitive wages
Family-friendly environment with average employee tenure above five years
